plain: It moves across the sky: about 0.30 arcseconds per year, measured over 13 years (a confident measurement), matching the catalog proper motion.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = at least 1.8 mag is very red, like T-type brown dwarfs.
Too few WISE measurements to tell whether its brightness changes.
SPHEREx does not clearly detect it at 3.5-5 micrometres, so its spectrum cannot be typed.
